characters.name: Den fremmede ridderen

characters.name: Den unge kongen
characters.description: Enkesønnen som har fått prinsessa og halve riket. Han glemmer aldri hesten som hjalp ham.
characters.look: A slim, kind-faced young king of about sixteen with warm olive-tan skin, an oval face, a straight nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick straight eyebrows, rosy cheeks and short, glossy blue-black hair, wavy on top, with a cowlick at the crown. characters.name: Den snakkende hesten (fortryllet prins)
characters.description: En klok, rolig hest som gir trygge råd, hjelper gutten å rømme, og viser seg til slutt å være en prins som blir fri fra en forbannelse.
characters.look: A big, powerful, coal-black horse with a glossy coat and no white markings at all, a long, thick, wavy mane and tail, a long forelock falling between his eyes, a proudly arched neck, a broad forehead, soft velvety nostrils, gentle, clever amber-brown eyes with long lashes, very expressive ears, and shaggy black feathering over his big round hooves.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: Den svarte hesten slik han egentlig er: en ung prins som ble trollet om til hest. Nå er han fri, og han og den unge kongen blir gode venner.
characters.look: A tall, broad-shouldered young man of about twenty-five with fair skin, a long, proud face, a high-bridged nose, clever amber-brown eyes, a short, neatly trimmed black beard and long, straight jet-black hair gathered at the nape into a thick tail that swings like a horse's tail. He wears a charcoal-black riding coat with silver frogging across the chest, a silver-grey cloak fastened with a silver horseshoe-shaped brooch, black breeches and tall black riding boots.

characters.name: Den fremmede mannen
characters.description: En streng og farlig herre som setter forbud og prøver å skremme gutten, men som til slutt mister makten når gutten får hjelp til å slippe unna.
characters.look: An unusually tall, gaunt figure who almost looks like a man: a long, craggy face with a stony grey complexion, a huge knobbly nose, small glinting black eyes under bushy iron-grey eyebrows, a wide thin mouth, big pointed ears and a short, bristly iron-grey beard. He has very long arms, huge knobbly hands and enormous flat feet in big black boots, and he wears a long black frock coat that reaches his ankles, buttoned with large horn buttons, and a tall, battered black hat.

characters.name: Prinsessa
characters.description: En modig og snill prinsesse som ser godheten i gutten og står opp for ham, og som gleder seg over at han hjelper riket.
characters.look: A warm, spirited princess of about seventeen with a round face, a small straight nose, bright hazel eyes, dimples and fair skin with rosy cheeks. Her dark-brown hair hangs in two long, thick braids tied with pink ribbons. She wears a rose-pink linen dress with puffed sleeves, a white embroidered collar and a darker pink sash, soft pink shoes, and a thin silver circlet set with a small pink stone.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: En streng, men rettferdig konge. Først blir han sint på gutten, men senere forstår han sannheten og belønner mot og godhet.
characters.look: A broad, barrel-chested, middle-aged king with a square, stern face, a big hooked nose, deep-set dark eyes under heavy black eyebrows, and a thick, bushy black beard streaked with grey. He wears a heavy crown of dark iron topped with gold points, a long dark-green velvet robe with gold trim, a broad brown leather belt with a big gold buckle and tall black riding boots.

places.name: the Great Bog
places.look: A wide, flat, soggy bog under an open sky, a patchwork of rust-red and olive-green moss with tussocks of reddish grass, dark peaty pools that mirror the sky, a few crooked little birch trees and a muddy cart track along its edge. Low, heather-covered hills and dark spruce forest ring it in the distance.

places.name: the Royal Garden
places.look: The garden of the king's farm: neat rows of carrots and cabbages, flower beds full of roses, gravel paths and a little white gate. In the middle stands a small red-painted gazebo with a pointed roof, raised on tall wooden stilts, with a steep wooden staircase leading up to it. Behind the garden rises the big two-storey royal hall of dark logs with a turf roof, carved gables and small-paned windows, and a round grey stone tower.
